understanding.goal_understanding: Place every selectable piece simultaneously on the goal tiles marked '+'; the level is won only when all goals are occupied and the engine reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move on a 3-pixel-per-cell grid using directional actions, while walls or boundaries can block movement and adjacent pushable blocks may move when pushed. CLICK switches control to a selectable piece using its pixel coordinates, but switching does not itself place pieces on goals; all pieces must remain positioned on goals simultaneously before the step budget expires.

understanding.goal_understanding: Place every selectable piece simultaneously on the goal tiles marked '+'; the level is won only when all goals are occupied and the engine reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move on a 3-pixel-per-cell grid using directional actions, while walls or boundaries can block movement and adjacent pushable blocks may move when pushed. CLICK switches control to a selectable piece using its pixel coordinates, but switching does not itself place pieces on goals; all pieces must remain positioned on goals simultaneously before the step budget expires.
